text: Liquid Inference 是供 DSH 使用的模型路由与只读市场查询插件。它通过配置内置的 OpenAI Chat Completions 适配器接入 Liquid，提供 liquid.auto、按价格或档位排序的路由变体及 DeepSeek V4 Flash。插件还注册四个工具，用于查看报价、市场深度、路由模型和已结算任务收据。适合希望在 DSH 中调用 Liquid 推理并查阅市场信息的用户。模型调用和任务收据需要买方密钥；市场查询无需密钥。

Liquid Inference adds Liquid routing and market tools to DSH. It configures the built-in OpenAI-compatible adapter with liquid.auto, ranking variants, and DeepSeek V4 Flash. Four tools show offers, markets, routers, and receipts. Model requests and receipts need a buyer key; public queries do not.
想在 DSH 里用 Liquid 的模型路由来生成回答。
有没有办法按价格档位选择推理模型？
我想查看推理市场上有哪些模型报价。
怎么查某个模型的市场深度和提供方报价？
I want to see available inference router models in DSH.
How can I look up the receipt and cost for a settled inference job?
Liquid Inference 的功能「Liquid 模型路由」：配置 DSH 内置 OpenAI 兼容适配器，提供 liquid.auto 档位变体及 DeepSeek V4 Flash。
Liquid Inference 的功能「报价查询」：报价查询：调用 liquid_get_book 查看按生成价格排序的匿名报价，可按模型名筛选并限制返回数量。
Liquid Inference 的功能「市场深度」：市场深度：调用 liquid_get_markets 查询各服务模型的独立提供方与报价行，可按名称筛选结果。
Liquid Inference 的功能「路由目录」：路由目录：调用 liquid_get_routers 获取可用路由模型及其排序规则，无需参数或买方密钥。
Liquid Inference 的功能「任务收据」：任务收据：提供任务 ID 调用 liquid_get_job，查看已结算任务的费用、token 计量、耗时和路由信息；需要买方密钥。
Liquid Inference 使用模型路由时，提示和工具结果会发送到 router.inference.ai.exchange，并由其转发给中标的第三方提供方。
Liquid Inference 的任务收据查询需要 LIQUID_API_KEY；公开市场查询不需密钥，密钥从凭据服务或环境变量按请求读取。

dsh-liquid-inference README · dsh-liquid-inference：[Liquid Inference](https://liquidinference.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a `liquid` model route plus read-only market tools.

dsh-liquid-inference README · Install：Not published to npm yet. Install from GitHub or from a packed tarball, then export a buyer key with the `spend` scope and restart the profile:

```sh
export LIQUID_API_KEY=sk-liquid-...
```

**From GitHub.** The built `lib/` is committed, so no build step or `allowBuilds` entry is needed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin
```

Pin a commit (`github:architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin#<sha>`) so a later push cannot change what you install.

dsh-liquid-inference README · Install：**From a tarball.** Needs no build permission:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin.git
cd liquid-dsh-plugin && pnpm install && pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-liquid-inference-0.1.0.tgz
```

Pick **Liquid Auto** (`liquid.auto`) in the model picker.

dsh-liquid-inference README · What it adds：**Model route `liquid`** — no adapter code. The bundle patch configures the stock `llm-pi-ai` adapter with `api: openai-completions`, `baseURL: https://router.inference.ai.exchange/v1` and `apiKeyEnv: LIQUID_API_KEY`.

dsh-liquid-inference README · What it adds：- **Cap.** Each request carries `x-liquid-cap-usd`, the most it can cost, locked before the first token. The default is 1 USD; set `LIQUID_CAP_USD` in the launching environment to change it.
- **Models.** `liquid.auto` plus its ranking variants `:cheapest`, `:economy`, `:balanced` and `:premium` (documented in the description of `GET /v1/exchange/routers`), and `deepseek-v4-flash` as a pinned model. Add any id from `GET /v1/models` with a `models` entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- **Reasoning.** Levels `low`, `medium` and `high` are sent as `reasoning_effort`. The exchange passes the level through unchecked, so a level the winning provider rejects fails that request.

dsh-liquid-inference README · What it adds：**Tools** (plugin `liquid-inference`)

| Tool | Endpoint | Key |
|---|---|---|
| `liquid_get_book` | `GET /v1/exchange/offers` | no |
| `liquid_get_markets` | `GET /v1/exchange/markets` | no |
| `liquid_get_routers` | `GET /v1/exchange/routers` | no |
| `liquid_get_job` | `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` | yes |

Chat, image, speech and video purchases are deliberately not tools: the harness's own model route is the one place that spends.

dsh-liquid-inference README · Data flow：Full prompts and tool results go to `router.inference.ai.exchange`, which forwards them to whichever third-party provider wins the auction. The key is read per request, from the credential store when the profile mounts one and from `LIQUID_API_KEY` otherwise (headless profiles disable the store). It is never written to config.

dsh-liquid-inference README · Notes：- The patch replaces the `llm-pi-ai` row's whole `config`. If another bundle also configures pi-ai providers, restate them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- Develop: `pnpm install && pnpm run check`. Commit the rebuilt `lib/` with source changes (CI fails on a stale one). `pnpm run test:install` packs the bundle, installs the tarball into an isolated profile of a real dsh (`DSH_VERSION` picks the release, default `next`) and boots it; it needs network access.
